name: Monforte de Moyuela (Spain)
description: Dark blue field with a triangle of the bars of Aragon issuing from the fly, charged at the hoist with a yellow crowned letter M.
history: Municipal flag of Monforte de Moyuela; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
